findings.summary: crew directory calls directory() without ready_idle, so the unfiltered CLI listing no longer shows a coordinator that has ready-idle work and no run - a row it showed before the fix, and the surface the plan's power_convertor measurement was taken through. The file is outside the node's write paths, the node recorded it in outside_scope with the one-argument remedy, and it should be folded into a one-line node rather than exempted.

the control log's final receipt reads EXIT=0 while the same log reports '1 failed', so a reader scripting on the EXIT line concludes the pre-fix head passed; the failing assertion is present in the text and the declared negative_control.log ends EXIT=1, so admission is unaffected but the artifact misstates its own outcome.
